claims.claim: An affine coset of modular holonomy vectors contains a vector attaining the gcd of all offset and generator entries.
claims.scope: Explicitly listed variables; cyclic translations; exact minimum component count.
claims.evidence: Article sections2–3; affine_modular.py; 63,886 independent arithmetic cases.
claims.remaining: No arbitrary topology predicate or parameter-isomorphism classification.

claims.claim: Factor-free deterministic polynomial bit construction of an attaining assignment, with exact seam feasibility and solution count.
claims.scope: Size charges variable dimensions, coefficient lengths, and explicit witness output.
claims.evidence: Bounded-residue congruence reduction and gcd saturation proofs; independent original-variable enumeration.
claims.remaining: The solution_count field is not part of the minimal independent certificate contract.

claims.claim: Primal/dual modular identities certify exact optimality; a separating modular row certifies infeasibility.
claims.scope: Verifier uses modular products and gcds without a kernel solve or optimizer call.
claims.evidence: Finite-ring annihilator proof; malformed-certificate and large-JSON transport tests.
claims.remaining: Geometry must be freshly compiled and separately satisfy its input contract.

claims.claim: Connected full-boundary assemblies of affine cyclic surface covers compile to congruences and affine loop voltages.
claims.scope: Local covers may be disconnected; all maps are translations on a common fibre.
claims.evidence: Seam compatibility and spanning-tree proof; 120 seeded families, 1,337 original assignments.
claims.remaining: No general extraction from a normal-surface search or knot exterior into these families.

claims.claim: Simultaneous designated-boundary connectedness is NP-complete for affine three-sheeted planar cyclic covers.
claims.scope: Arbitrary affine correlations; whole preimage of each designated boundary.
claims.evidence: Explicit graph three-colouring reduction; 351 native cover-profile checks.
claims.remaining: This is not an unknot-recognition hardness theorem, nor an unconditional exclusion of quasi-polynomial time.

claims.claim: Exact connected-assignment counts obey a prime-local product when modulus factors are known; general exact counting includes totient computation.
claims.scope: Counts labelled parameter assignments, not cover isomorphism classes.
claims.evidence: Uniform affine-image and CRT proof; semiprime factor recovery reduction.
claims.remaining: No factor-free polynomial exact connected-assignment counter is claimed.

claims.claim: Actual admissible normal coordinates yield at most 5t disc stacks and five signed interval bands per paired face.
claims.scope: Manifold precondition; matching and quadrilateral conditions checked; binary endpoints.
claims.evidence: Face-order proof; 1,537 rational geometry cases and 807 Regina inputs.
claims.remaining: No full residual handle structure or general interval-orbit reducer.

claims.claim: Consecutive-disc prism gaps have the corrected reflection offset; each paired face has at most two singleton prism-to-residue contacts, and each tetrahedron has at most six residual local cells.
claims.scope: Local complement and frontier data with provenance.
claims.evidence: Local-cell and transition proofs; independent exact disc/prism pair comparison.
claims.remaining: Global edge regularization, boundary patterns and parallelity bundles still require implementation.

claims.claim: Full scalar endomorphism algebras of connected children are transported parent corners, with a canonical basis identical to a fresh solve.
claims.scope: Same complex, admissible scalar blocks, inherited labels; no crossing attachment reuse.
claims.evidence: Extension-by-zero and canonical-pivot proofs; random space equality, grading, cache and witness checks.
claims.remaining: Transport cost may exceed sparse recomputation; no intrinsic size bound on parent algebra.

claims.claim: A generator whose actual minimal degree equals full commutant dimension and whose Frobenius fixed space has dimension one certifies scalar locality.
claims.scope: Scalar endomorphisms only; full dimension and exact minimal polynomial required.
claims.evidence: Saturation/locality proof; repeated-primary and unsaturated negative controls; independent certificate audits.
claims.remaining: No statement about arbitrary cobordism-valued idempotents or knot triviality.

claims.claim: A saturated monogenic parent transports one generator to describe complete child corners.
claims.scope: Current code finishes local children and resumes bounded search on nonlocal power bases.
claims.evidence: Monogenic corner proof; dense two-field fixtures and nonlocal child test.
claims.remaining: An unlimited complete primary decomposition is a theorem-level consequence, not the current global scanner policy.

claims.status: exact work-count result and controlled measurement
claims.claim: Attached-copy equation construction drops from a cubic sum to 2r²; r=16 paired speedup 1.468×; dense two-field one-generator speedups 2.165–2.312×.
claims.scope: Specified algebraic fixtures; capped cases and raised-cap cases marked separately.
claims.evidence: Seven randomized paired rounds with A/A controls and byte-preserving output checks.
claims.remaining: Small cases can slow; these ratios are not total asymptotic exponents.

claims.claim: Natural commutant computations decrease for Conway and Kinoshita–Terasaka, but wall-time ratios remain near one.
claims.scope: Six complete raw scans at common preselected orders.
claims.evidence: Ratios 0.961–1.022× for inheritance; no primary/locality/monogenic activation in the sample.
claims.remaining: No convincing natural-knot or complete-recognizer wall-time improvement established.

claims.claim: A general quasi-polynomial unknot-recognition algorithm is the continuing objective.
claims.scope: All preprocessing, states, failed branches, resets, bit lengths and verdict completeness.
claims.evidence: Only a conditional composition theorem is proved here.
claims.remaining: Bound reachable states and encodings; establish geometric coverage and restart accounting.
